howItWorks.title: Feed the system. Get ranked matches.
howItWorks.lede: Click each stage or watch the console cycle: ingest profile data, process queries, output reasoned results.
howItWorks.cadenceBody: Matching runs on profile creation, when you edit qualifications, skills, or country, and on a weekly schedule — not on every dashboard visit.
howItWorks.trustBody: We surface listings from real boards and portals. Always verify deadlines on the source site. Past deadlines are filtered out of your dashboard.
howItWorks.ctaTitle: Ready to try it with your profile?
howItWorks.ctaBody: Create an account and finish onboarding to generate your first matches.

features.title: Two matchers. One profile.
features.lede: Scholarships worldwide. Jobs by country. Scores and reasons stay on the card.
features.scholarshipBody: Your degrees and skills drive the search. Each scholarship card shows score + why it fits.
features.jobBody: Same profile, second engine. Jobs respect the country you chose — with transparent fit notes.
features.profileTitle: Guided onboarding, not a wall of fields
features.profileBody: Country → about you → qualifications → skills. Editing later rematches automatically.
features.privacyBody: GDPR-level deletion for everyone. Profile removal cascades to skills, quals, and matches.
features.gridReasonBody: Why each match fits sits on the card — not behind a modal.
features.gridMobileBody: Most applicants arrive on a phone; layout and motion respect that.
features.gridAdsBody: At most 1–2 units, never inside forms or the matching flow.
features.ctaBody: Jump to the animated walkthrough, or start building your profile.

about.title: Scholarships and jobs, matched with reasons.
about.lede: Built for people who are tired of scrolling generic boards. Enter what you’ve studied and what you can do — we rank openings and say why they fit.
about.ideaTitle: Matching should feel like a briefing, not a dump of links.
about.ideaBody1: Search engines and opportunity boards show volume. They rarely know your Computer Science degree, your React skills, or that you’re applying from Botswana — and they almost never explain the fit.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic keeps one living profile and runs scholarship and job matching against it. Every result carries a score, a source, and a reason you can actually use.
about.p1Body: Degrees, skills, and country are the source of truth. Matches rebuild when you change them.
about.p2Body: A score without an explanation is noise. We write why a listing fits — in plain language.
about.p3Body: We discover and rank. You apply on the official scholarship or employer site.
about.areItem2: Playbook tips unique to your skills and goals
about.areItem3: Save, dismiss, and rematch when your profile changes
about.notItem1: We don’t grant scholarships or hire anyone
about.notItem2: We don’t guarantee acceptance or funding
about.notItem3: Always verify deadlines on the official listing
about.studioBody: Opportunistic™ is a Futurify Designs product — designed to feel precise, calm, and useful, not like another template board.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to hand it your profile?
about.ctaBody: Create an account, confirm skills from your degree, and open ranked matches with reasons.

onboarding.guideCountryTitle: Where should we look for jobs?
onboarding.guideCountryTip: Pick the country you want job matches for. Scholarships stay worldwide, with a preference for your region.
onboarding.guideCountryWhy: Jobs are filtered by this country. Changing it later rematches automatically.
onboarding.guideYouTip: Name is required. Headline is your one-line summary — like a short bio for matching.
onboarding.guideYouWhy: This is how matches “talk” about you in reasoning lines.
onboarding.guideQualsTitle: What have you studied or earned?
onboarding.guideQualsTip: Add degrees or certificates. Field matters most (e.g. Computer Science). Institution and year help ranking.
onboarding.guideQualsWhy: Qualifications drive scholarship fit and career-level job matches.
onboarding.guideSkillsTip: Tick skills that match your degree. Add anything missing under Other.
onboarding.guideSkillsWhy: Checked skills drive job queries and make scholarship reasoning specific — not generic.
onboarding.guideProcessTip: We’ll lock your profile, search, score, and return reasoned matches — like briefing an assistant.
onboarding.guideProcessWhy: No extra forms. When this finishes, your dashboard opens with results.

match.gone: This match is no longer available. It may have been refreshed after a profile update.
match.emptyBody: Return to the dashboard and open a current match. Saving your profile rebuilds results from your latest data.
match.playbookNote: Unique tips built from your profile, skills, and this listing. They refresh when you edit your profile — or tap New tips.
match.eligibilityNote: Always confirm the latest rules on the official source — programs change by cycle and nationality.
